_comment: Overnight batch from the bank's CRM. This is the shape the client asked
for: no real-time core banking query, a daily push, and a tolerated
one-day lag. Every campaign decision the assistant makes is read from
this file, which is why those turns are deterministic and auditable -
the bot never decides who is eligible, it only reads who was selected.
generated_at is shown to the customer-facing agent so the age of the data
source: Trích xuất CRM hằng ngày v3
